processing: Modified from Fredoka One (OFL-1.1); renamed because the licence reserves the name Fredoka. Five glyphs only.
recipe: Units per em 1000; line metrics, advance widths and hinting tables copied from Fredoka One.
s with cedilla: s plus the font's cedilla moved 27 left; S with cedilla: S plus the cedilla moved 24 right (outlines merged in both).
I with dot above: I plus the dot of Fredoka One's i (its second contour) moved 1 right and 200 up.
g with breve: g plus a drawn breve centred at x 303, top at y 773; G with breve: G plus the breve centred at x 354, top at y 973.
The breve is an arc of a circle 400 wide and 183 high including a 108 thick stroke with round ends (400 is the width of the font's caron).
Name table 'Neconyan Heading Letters' (ids 1, 4, 6); packed as woff2.
